verdict.rationale: Azure documents managed identities that let applications obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without managing any credentials, which covers the 'services' half of the story with no long-lived keys. The pack has nothing on OIDC or workload identity federation for external CI systems, and nothing showing short-lived credential issuance to pipelines end to end. missing for 10: workload identity federation/OIDC trust for CI providers, documented end-to-end CI setup, evidence of token lifetime and short-lived scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
